name: Physical scarcity
description: Power, grid, cooling and the actuation chain: what the buildout physically consumes and cannot synthesise.

name: Compute & platforms
description: Frontier silicon and the platforms that own the model layer. Real but depreciating: bought on drawdowns, held smaller.

name: Survivors, tolls & second wave
description: Businesses AI feeds rather than eats: data moats, agent rails, machine identity, and oligopolies whose cost base AI cuts.

name: Moonshots
description: Pre-scale, binary outcomes with 10× asymmetry. Deliberately capped: no single position above 1% of the book.

name: Macro scenario bets
description: Hard-money and real-asset expressions of the fiscal path funding the buildout. Bets, not hedges: they fall with the book in a reset.

name: Reserve & optionality
description: Cash and the put overlay. Dry powder for the drawdown the strategy is built to buy, plus the book's actual insurance.
